messages:
ana: quick async sync on hotpath work — wanted to post status and concrete action items for the next 24h. goal: land M2 perf milestone (kernel microbatch + continuous batching + kv warmup) and get a safe canary. owners: kernel=raj, batching=mike, kv=lee. blocker: eng-platform needs bootstrap flag for stateless shard (ENGPLAT-482). raj — can you confirm PR status and ETA for merge?

mike: working on batching perf PR (#4223). local perf: ~12% p99 reduction on sample trace with 25ms window. waiting on infra to flip `ENABLE_CONT_BATCH=true` on canary pool. cc @eng-infra — opened ENG-OPS-8921 to request flag.

raj: kernel PR #4198 merged to staging this morning. not rolling to canary until kv-warmup tests pass. i can run a manual canary tomorrow 09:30 PT if kv looks green. i also added a metric: `kernel.processed_batches` to help gate.

lee: kv warmup patch is in draft (PR #4235). eviction threshold tweak earlier caused a regen flake; running controlled benches now. will attach traces and mem profiles to the PR.

sophia: pushed a small change to the QA harness to replay production traces against new kernel/batching combos. test plan doc here: https://rwd.in/doc/kv-warmup-plan (internal). i'll post failures to this thread by EOD.

deploy-bot: deploy started: canary/runtime-hotpath/2026-03-18-09:45 - status pending

ana: (note: typo above -> ana) ana: action items from me:
  1) @raj run manual canary tomorrow 09:30 PT and watch tail latency; rollback if p99 > 75ms or errors spike
  2) @mike follow up with infra (ENG-OPS-8921) to flip flag on canary pool
  3) @lee move PR out of draft once bench+mem profile look OK; post artifacts
  4) @sophia run replays and post top-3 failure traces by EOD
  I'll thin-slice the rollout: kernel -> batching -> kv (canary gating between steps).

raj: ack. scheduled manual canary. if we see tail latency > 75ms or error rate > 0.5% i'll roll back and notify here. also i'll watch `kernel.processed_batches` and `rpc.queue_latency`.

mike: pinged infra — ENG-OPS ticket created (8921). small question: any objections to bumping batching window from 20ms -> 30ms in canary? saw slightly lower throughput but consistent p99 decrease in local runs.

lee: no objection, i'll run mem + alloc profiles with 30ms and post results. if memory pressure looks OK i'll update draft to non-draft.

sophia: fwiw my replay showed flakiness correlated with eviction threshold 0.12. moving to 0.15 reduced flakes in 3/3 runs. will include logs.

ana: thanks everyone. quick run command for kv warmup testing (for reproducibility):
```
# run kv warmup replay locally
./bin/kv-warmup --trace traces/prod-20260317.json --eviction-threshold 0.15 
```

ana: final note: i'll update the sprint board to mark dependent tickets and set the canary docs. closing async thread — please post final canary result here or DM if urgent. :thumbsup:

raj: thanks — will report results after manual canary. :eyes:
